step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture processes real-time parking data and performs ML predictions. Data flows from IoT Parking sensors into Kinesis Firehose, processed by a Lambda function, and saved into DynamoDB for real-time access and S3 for long-term storage. S3 feeds SageMaker for model training orchestrated by Step Functions. CodeCommit triggers Lambda deployments. API Gateway routes user requests to a query Lambda that reads from DynamoDB and SageMaker.
